hypothesis: Immediate custom-write/read handoff is one CCK too slow with cold Copper.
competitor: The custom write shifts all subsequent execution, regardless of the following read gap.
test: Cross0..3 trailing NOPs with write/NOP actor and cold/warm Copper, four phases and repeats; exact pre-enable beam and finite activity witness.

outcomes.error persists: Inspect grant timing of the write or initial request.
outcomes.controls change: Keep raw evidence and narrow before patching.

next_question: Does adding a ROM gap remove the cold custom-write residual?

measurements.name: post_write
measurements.meaning: First beam after COLOR00 write or four NOPs

hardware.limitations: PAL A500 stock68000,512KiB chip/512KiB slow; silicon revisions unconfirmed. Master DMA pre-enabled; cold/warm finite Copper WAIT/INTREQ stream and bitplane contention active. No blitter or sprite DMA. Compare exact pre-enable cohorts; no trace alignment.
